title: Truth Labs International — DPDP Gap Assessment
subtitle: 60-question Microsoft Forms Quick Import source
draft_status: For pilot build only. Legal and methodology approval is required before client use.
import_note: In Microsoft Forms, use Quick Import to upload this Word document. After import, verify every question, answer choice, section and Required setting. Quick Import may not preserve section structure or metadata perfectly. The separate Excel build sheet retains legal references, applicability guidance, evidence expectations, weights and recommendations.
respondent_instructions: Select the response that best describes the current state. Do not select “Not applicable” without providing a justification in the follow-up field. Evidence will be collected and validated separately by the Truth Labs assessor.

assessor_only_reference.notice: Do not place all legal references, evidence instructions and remediation recommendations into the public respondent form. Keep them in the restricted SharePoint DPDP_QuestionBank and assessor workspace. Use QuestionCode to map each response back to the approved question-bank record.
assessor_only_reference.scoring_defaults_proposal: Scoring defaults for MVP (subject to methodology approval): Implemented = 100; Partially implemented = 50; Not implemented = 0; Unknown / not verified = unscored pending review; Not applicable = excluded only after written justification and assessor approval. Report readiness score, evidence coverage and assessment completeness separately.

proposed_score_values.Not applicable — justification required: excluded only after written justification and assessor approval
